posts.author: Tuftycurlew
posts.body:
Hello everyone! I'm entirely new here and want to learn how to program (specifically RPG Maker VX Ace)
Thing is, I'm completely new at programming, and I've been fruitless trying to find anywhere I can learn. I've tried simply looking up Ruby tutorials, and that hasn't helped much. I need a sort of walkthrough for scripting?
Any help is appreciated!
I'm trying to make an indie horror game, so I'm trying to get rid of all the menu stuff and just make a really simple pause menu.

posts.author: kyonides
posts.body: You still need to read Ruby tutorials to learn about how Ruby truly works. That's something several scripters forgot to do or didn't take it seriously. For instance, learn how to use classes, modules, arrays [], nested arrays [[],[]], hashes {}, :symbols, def methods, variables, @variables, @@variables and $variables.
